name: cluster
description: A row of children with a gap that wraps when it runs out of room: an action row, a preview's links, a field with its button. It sits on an element that already exists or wraps children; it never knows what its children are. A child takes a placement role with data-place: grow (takes the room left) or fixed (keeps its own size).

tag.description: The element it is drawn on, when it is not put on an existing one.

children.description: In reading order. A child may carry data-place="grow" or data-place="fixed".

exposes.--aj-l-cluster-gap: The gap between children, row then column as in gap (default 0). The owner sets it on its own element, or legacy CSS during the migration.

states.hover: n/a: arrangement only, never a control
states.focus-visible: n/a: arrangement only; its children carry the ring
states.empty: n/a: an arrangement with no children is not drawn

changelog.change: New layout primitive (decision 2026-10-12: a parent's placement of its children lives in layout primitives). A wrapping row with a gap; children grow or stay fixed.
